subject: Request: Trial extension & credits due to SDK deprecation - Novalytics
messages:
From: Samira Kahn <samira@novalytics.io>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot blocked by vendor SDK deprecation - urgent request for extension/credits

Hi Lauren,

Quick note from our engineering lead: during the final verification run for the Redwood connector we discovered that our third-party ETL vendor pushed a breaking change to their SDK overnight. The change removes a legacy checksum call that our adapter depends on, so the connector fails during ingestion (see attached integration_log_snip.txt).

This is a hard blocker for the pilot — we were planning the final demo for this Friday but the engineering team needs at least two weeks to patch and QA (could be longer if we run into downstream schema drift).

Given the timeline, can Redwood provide: 
- A 30-day trial extension so we can finish the integration and demo internally
- A small sandbox/top-up credit to cover increased testing (we expect ~50k tokens for the next two weeks)

We love the product and want to keep this moving; asking because the outage is due to an external vendor change (not Redwood). Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Samira Kahn
Head of Integrations, Novalytics
samira@novalytics.io
+1 415-555-0198

On attachments: integration_log_snip.txt (text)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Kahn <samira@novalytics.io>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by vendor SDK deprecation - urgent request for extension/credits

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and for the log snippet. Sorry to hear this popped up so late.

Quick answers: we can absolutely review an extension + sandbox top-up. I want to confirm a couple things before I escalate to Finance for promotional credits:
- Target extension length you need (you mentioned 2 weeks of patch + QA; would you prefer 30 or 45 days?)
- Estimated token/top-up amount — you suggested ~50k tokens, is that over the next two weeks or across the whole extension window?

I’ve looped in Dev (Dev Patel) and CS (Marissa) to validate the technical ETA and to prepare an amended agreement if we approve credits. If you can share one-sentence remediation ETA from your engineering lead (e.g., "patch + QA = 10 business days"), that will help speed approval.

I’ll queue this as high priority. We want the demo to go well.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:25:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Pilot blocked by vendor SDK deprecation - urgent request for extension/credits

Lauren — quick technical read: thanks for the log. Looks like the ETL vendor removed a non-critical checksum call; the fix is straightforward (update adapter to use the new handshake call + fallback). Rough ETA: 8-12 business days for dev + internal QA; another 3 business days for Novalytics to run their verification. So 15 business days total is a conservative timeline.

Recommendation for the commercial ask: 
- Approve 30 calendar days extension now (covers the conservative ETA plus a small buffer).
- Approve a promotional sandbox credit equivalent to 75k tokens to be safe (covers testing during patching + demo rehearsal).

If leadership needs cost numbers: 75k tokens at our promo rate = approx $1,350. Happy to provide cost breakout if required.

I can attach a brief technical note for the CS/Finance reviewers describing the root cause and why this is an external-vendor issue.

—Dev (on call if we need to jump on a screen share with Novalytics engineers)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Kahn <samira@novalytics.io>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by vendor SDK deprecation - urgent request for extension/credits

Hi Samira — good news: we can approve an interim solution to keep your pilot on track while your team patches. Here’s what we are prepared to do immediately: 

1) Grant a 30-day trial extension starting today (new expiry: 2026-12-01).
2) Apply a promotional sandbox credit equivalent to 75,000 tokens to your Novalytics pilot workspace (internal value for accounting: $1,350).
3) I’ve attached a short amendment document (Novalytics-Amendment-v1.pdf) that formalizes the extension and the sandbox uplift. If that looks good, I’ll route for e-signature via DocuSign and get Finance to note the promo line on the account.

Next steps for you: please confirm whether you accept the 30-day extension and token uplift. If you need 45 days instead, let me know and I’ll ask for an escalated sign-off (possible but takes longer).

I’ve CC’d Ben from Commercial Ops so he can flag any billing/PO considerations. Marissa will coordinate a post-fix verification call to make sure the demo goes smoothly. Dev is on standby to do a joint debugging session if helpful.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: Novalytics-Amendment-v1.pdf (amendment stub)
Related DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/templates/amendment-novalytics
From: Samira Kahn <samira@novalytics.io>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by vendor SDK deprecation - urgent request for extension/credits

Lauren — that is perfect, thank you. Novalytics accepts the 30-day extension and the 75k token sandbox uplift. I’ve routed the amendment to our legal team and expect to countersign by EOD tomorrow.

We’ll also schedule a short run-through with your Dev team next Wednesday to validate the patched adapter. 

Appreciate the fast turn-around on this — it makes a big difference for our pilot momentum.

Best,
Samira
